lines: d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Stephen Schuster is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d34: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d34: 🕯️ Stephen Schuster is dead — sickness. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d34: What Stephen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d34: "Stephen's gone." Aaron looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Stephen." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d34: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Dmitri blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Wiring & Circuits (Level 1). Volts, amps, and why you respect both. Safe splices, real grounds, no shortcuts.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d34: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Stephen Schuster, 34 days. The mantle passes to Dmitri Sokolov.
d34: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Dmitri Sokolov, 41 — an appliance repair tech. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d34: The village's quarrel was with Stephen — and Stephen is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d34: At the grave, Milton, Eric, Aaron and 6 more speak for Dmitri — "Stephen trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d34: The fire knew Dmitri before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Dmitri Sokolov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
